title: Decision Reviews and Appeals Quick Reference: Permitted Lane for the Decision Being Reviewed
content:
**Decision Reviews and Appeals — quick reference on the lane permitted for the decision being reviewed**

**Rule.** The lane chosen must be one allowed after the decision being reviewed: a lane that may not be chosen again for a decision issued in that same lane cannot review a decision issued in that same lane, and only a lane that may be chosen to review a Board decision can follow a Board decision. A claimant can never hold a Higher-Level Review and a supplemental claim on the same issue at the same time.

**The two properties, lane by lane**

| Lane | May review a decision issued in this same lane | May follow a Board decision |
|---|---|---|
| Supplemental Claim | Yes | Yes |
| Higher-Level Review | No | No |
| Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference | No | No |
| Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket | No | No |
| Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | No | No |
| Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | No | No |

**Reading the card**

1. *Decision issued in a lane.* Look up the lane in which the decision being reviewed was issued. If the requested lane is that same lane, the request is allowed only where the first column reads Yes — that is, only for the Supplemental Claim.
2. *Decision issued by the Board.* A decision issued on any of the three Board dockets is a Board decision. Only a lane whose second column reads Yes can follow it — that is, only the Supplemental Claim.
3. *Higher-Level Review and supplemental claim together.* Whatever the decision, a Higher-Level Review and a supplemental claim are never held on the same issue at the same time.

**Hypothetical decisions and the lanes this rule addresses**

| Decision being reviewed (hypothetical) | Requested lane | Result under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| Decision issued in the Supplemental Claim lane | Supplemental Claim | Allowed: the Supplemental Claim may review a decision issued in that same lane |
| Decision issued in the Higher-Level Review lane | Higher-Level Review | Not allowed: same lane, and that lane may not review its own decision |
| Decision issued on the Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | Not allowed: it is a Board decision, and that docket may not follow one |
| Decision issued on the Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket | Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | Not allowed: it is a Board decision, and that docket may not follow one |
| Decision issued on the Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | Supplemental Claim | Allowed: the Supplemental Claim may follow a Board decision |
| Any decision; the claimant already holds a Higher-Level Review on the issue | Supplemental Claim on the same issue | Not allowed while the Higher-Level Review is held |
